bio: The large windows, fireplace and marble counter are sure to draw your eye as you enter this sleek brasserie. Foodwise, things are rather traditional: savour timeless classics such as crispy shrimp croquettes with that typical full flavour, herby eel in a green sauce, and rich chocolate mousse. With so many tempting options on the menu, it's never easy to decide what to order. The expertise of the seasoned chef shines through in this exemplary establishment....
